art_style.one_sentence: Expressive neighborhood identity built from imperfect black ink, simplified silhouettes, custom lettering, and generous white space.

core_invariants: black ink on white or paper-like background
friendly, local, handmade, slightly quirky personality
clear neighborhood, service, craft, retail, or community context

composition_archetypes.name: mascot
composition_archetypes.description: Person, object, tool, or product becomes a character through expressive posture, gesture, or interaction; food mascots are optional.

composition_archetypes.name: emblem
composition_archetypes.description: Compact mark with one strong dark organic anchor and reverse lettering or white linework.

composition_archetypes.name: storefront
composition_archetypes.description: Isometric kiosk, stall, or shop with small architectural details and hand-lettered signage.

composition_archetypes.name: market-scene
composition_archetypes.description: Worker, customer, maker, counter, tools, packages, or objects arranged on a grounding baseline.

detail_range.minimum: bold silhouette with one memorable detail
detail_range.maximum: fine facade, packaging, clothing, or food texture details without losing the silhouette

recommended_direction.hybrid_formula: Image 3 anchor silhouette + Image 4 human warmth + Image 1 micro-details + Image 2 gesture energy applied to original people or objects
recommended_direction.reason: This preserves the human, environmental, and object details that create personality while avoiding copied motifs.

logo_system.optional: simplified secondary mark derived from the vignette
logo_system.rule: Do not force the optional secondary mark to replace the primary illustration.
logo_system.selection_method: Choose one evocative brand interaction and reduce it to the essential visual cues.
logo_system.distinctness_rule: Sibling logo directions must differ in silhouette and framing; do not repeat the same interior, character pairing, or object cluster.

originality_guardrails.principle: borrow the medium, not the motifs
originality_guardrails.signature_device_rule: Add one original recurring device per brand, such as connected steam-like lines, a recurring awning, a stamp edge, a counter baseline, or a distinctive object rhythm.
originality_guardrails.generation_rule: Use the source references to understand style, not as direct composition inputs for the final concept.

strokes.name: ink-imperfection
strokes.value: subtle stroke irregularity and uneven spacing

lettering.name: reverse-emblem-type
lettering.value: rounded lettering knocked out of a dark organic shape

surface.name: flat-ink
surface.value: opaque black fill with white cutouts

composition_rules: Make the subject recognizable as a silhouette before detail is inspected.
Center or intentionally balance the subject around a clear focal point.
Use a baseline for counter or market scenes.
Use diagonal or isometric construction only when it adds character or world-building.
Allow asymmetry when it creates personality.
Keep generous white space around compact marks.
lettering_rules: Treat lettering as part of the illustration, not as a separate typesetting layer.
Prefer custom lettering or manually altered type.
Use irregular spacing, narrow proportions, or rounded forms when appropriate.
Do not default to a generic corporate sans-serif.
avoid: color before monochrome identity is strong
evaluation_criteria: reads as a silhouette at thumbnail size
business, service, craft, or neighborhood context is clear
contains one memorable gesture, shape, or character detail
feels plausible for a distinctive neighborhood brand
lettering feels integrated with the drawing
story reads through one action, one anchor, and one supporting cue

open_decisions: final balance between mascot and emblem
whether future work should remain strictly black-and-white
confidence.note: This is a chosen design direction synthesized from the references, not a claim that every source image shares every token exactly.
